__comment: DelightfulCompat OVERRIDE of ramadandelight:small_dough_from_dough. Because we add small_dough to c:foods/dough, the original 'c:foods/dough -> 2x small_dough' recipe becomes a duplication loop. This override keeps the original ONLY when Farmer's Delight is absent (i.e. when our dough unification is not in play). When FD is present the neoforge:not condition fails and the recipe is dropped; small_dough is instead obtained via delightful_compat:small_dough_from_wheat_dough_cutting.
